text: Aflac Incorporated registers its Common Stock (symbol AFL) on the New York Stock Exchange. Its 2026 proxy statement lists the holders of more than 5% of its common stock as The Vanguard Group (11.1%), J&A Alliance Holdings Corporation as trustee of J&A Alliance Trust (10.2% of shares; the trust's sole settlor and beneficiary is Japan Post Holdings, its voting is capped at 20% and the proxy states Japan Post Holdings has no board seat and no rights to control, manage or intervene in the company) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.2%).
short: Aflac Incorporated is NYSE-listed (AFL); largest holders are asset managers and the Japan Post-alliance trust, with no board seat or control rights.

source.name: Aflac Incorporated: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, beneficial ownership of more than 5% of common stock; SEC EDGAR, filed 2026-03-19)
source.quote: Japan Post Holdings will not have a Board seat on the Company's Board of Directors and will not have rights to control, manage or intervene in the management of the Company
